key_findings.beyer_100_threshold: Historical Derby winners typically run Beyer 100+. Only TWO horses in PP1-12 meet it: Commandment (101 FL Derby), So Happy (100 SA Derby). From PP13-24, Further Ado (106 Blue Grass) leads the entire field.
key_findings.form_cliff_concern: Litmus Test PP4 staggered 12.5L back in Arkansas Derby — clear form regression
key_findings.renegade_workout_chatter: Private clockers report Renegade's mornings haven't been sharpest. Pletcher 2-for-65 lifetime; both wins on sloppy tracks
key_findings.chief_wallabee_blinkers_first_time: Mott adding blinkers; April 20 work called 'monster' / 'best I've seen by far'. Only 3 career starts though — least experienced in field
key_findings.incredibolt_2nd_fastest_breeze: Mott's Incredibolt 2nd-fastest of 71 at 4f at CD. 2-for-2 at Churchill specifically. But Beyer 88 ceiling
key_findings.so_happy_market_move: Opened 15-1 ML, now 6-1 — heavy public support post-Santa Anita Derby win
key_findings.danon_bourbon_market_move: Opened 20-1 ML, now 14-1 — sharp Japanese-shipper money
key_findings.commandment_sovereignty_pattern: Same exact prep sequence (Fountain of Youth → Florida Derby) as 2025 winner Sovereignty. Into Mischief sire has 3 Derby winners
key_findings.the_puma_runner_up_pattern: FL Derby 2nd by nose to Commandment — mirrors Mage 2023 + Sovereignty 2025 path
